approaches.name: The Analyst
approaches.blurb: Lives in EPA and success rate. Rewards efficient offenses, good quarterbacks and aggressive fourth-down decisions; treats momentum and turnovers as mostly noise.
approaches.home_field_why: Home field has shrunk to about 1.5 points

why.offense: Offensive efficiency is the most stable signal in football
why.quarterback: The quarterback is most of the offense
why.defense: Defense matters, but it's less stable than offense
why.quality: Results carry some signal; point differential beats record
why.coaching: Going for it and passing early are efficient decisions
why.health: Missing starters change the efficiency picture
why.venue_weather: Neutral sites and divisions shift home field a little
why.off_scheme: Motion and play-action help, as the data weighs them
why.def_scheme: Pressure helps, as the data weighs it
why.rest_travel: Rest is a small but real edge

approaches.name: The Sharp
approaches.blurb: Thinks like a professional bettor without copying the line: follows where the line moves, fades where the public piles in, trusts quarterback play and efficiency, and ignores streaks and hype.
approaches.home_field_why: Home field is worth about a point and a half, no more

why.quarterback: Quarterback play is the most underpriced edge
why.offense: Efficiency per play beats records and narratives
why.market: Follow the line moves, fade the public
why.defense: Defense matters, but it's noisier than offense
why.quality: Results matter only as far as they reflect efficiency
why.health: Injury news is often priced late
why.form: Fade recency: the public overreacts to streaks

approaches.name: The Student
approaches.blurb: Has no opinions. Starts by weighting everything equally and learns only from results.

approaches.name: The Traditionalist
approaches.blurb: Trusts the scoreboard, home crowds, rest, travel and who's hot. Thinks you win by running the ball and winning the turnover battle, and doesn't need a spreadsheet to tell him so.
approaches.home_field_why: Home field is worth a good 2.5 points

why.quality: Wins, who you beat, and winning the turnover battle
why.form: Momentum is real; hot teams stay hot
why.rest_travel: Fresh legs win late in the year; cross-country trips wear teams down
why.venue_weather: Crowds, domes and weather decide games
why.stakes: Teams play to what's on the line
why.coaching: Take the points, establish the run
why.quarterback: Good to have a QB, but it's a team game
why.offense: Has heard of EPA, doesn't really trust it

units.prob_diff: difference of two probabilities 0-1, shown as percentage points
units.epa: expected points added per play (or per game where noted)
units.index: a 0-to-N rating scale described in the feature

groups.name: Quality
groups.heading: Who's better
groups.meaning: The better team wins, judged by results
groups.description: How good each team has been by results: ratings, scoring margin, and schedule.

members.label: Elo rating
members.description: A running team-strength rating from game results and margins; 1500 is average.

members.label: Point differential per game
members.description: Points scored minus allowed per game this season, leaning on last season early in the year.

members.label: Expected win rate (points)
members.description: The win rate a team's points scored and allowed would normally produce (Pythagorean expectation).

members.label: Strength of schedule
members.description: Average Elo of the opponents faced so far this season.

members.label: Luck
members.description: Actual win rate minus expected win rate from points; teams that win more than their points say tend to come back down.

members.label: Turnover margin per game
members.description: Takeaways minus giveaways per game; partly skill, partly luck that regresses.

members.label: Special teams value
members.description: Expected points added per game by kickoffs, punts, field goals and returns.

groups.name: Offense
groups.heading: Who's better
groups.description: How efficiently each offense moves the ball, per play.

members.label: Offensive EPA per play
members.description: Expected points added per offensive play: how much each snap improves the scoring outlook. Around 0 is average, +0.1 is very good.

members.label: Offensive success rate
members.description: Share of offensive plays that improve the scoring outlook (EPA above zero).

members.label: Explosive play rate
members.description: Share of plays that are passes of 20+ yards or runs of 12+ yards.

members.label: Passing EPA per play
members.description: Expected points added per pass play, including sacks and scrambles.

members.label: Rushing EPA per play
members.description: Expected points added per designed run.

members.label: Early-down EPA per play
members.description: EPA per play on first and second down, a steadier signal than third downs.

members.label: EPA when the game is in doubt
members.description: EPA per play excluding garbage time (win probability under 10% or over 90%).

members.label: Opponent-adjusted offensive EPA
members.description: Offensive EPA per play after accounting for the defenses faced.

members.label: Sacks allowed rate
members.description: Share of dropbacks that end in a sack.

members.label: Drop rate
members.description: Share of catchable targets dropped (FTN charting, 2022+).

members.label: Contested catch rate
members.description: Share of targets that are contested catches (FTN charting, 2022+).

groups.name: Defense
groups.heading: Who's better
groups.description: How efficiently each defense stops the ball, per play (lower allowed is better).

members.label: EPA allowed per play
members.description: Expected points the defense allows per play; lower is better.

members.label: Success rate allowed
members.description: Share of opponent plays that improve their scoring outlook; lower is better.

members.label: Pass EPA allowed per play
members.description: Expected points allowed per opponent pass play.

members.label: Rush EPA allowed per play
members.description: Expected points allowed per opponent designed run.

members.label: Sack rate
members.description: Share of opponent dropbacks that end in a sack.

members.label: Opponent-adjusted EPA allowed
members.description: EPA allowed per play after accounting for the offenses faced.

groups.name: Quarterback
groups.heading: Who's playing
groups.meaning: Who is throwing, and is it the real guy
groups.description: The projected starting quarterback's track record, and whether he is the usual starter.

members.label: QB EPA per dropback
members.description: The projected starter's career expected points added per dropback, recent seasons weighted more; backups sit near replacement level.

members.label: QB completion % over expected
members.description: How much more often the projected starter completes passes than the difficulty of his throws predicts.

members.label: Starting QB out
members.description: The depth-chart starter is listed Out or Doubtful.

members.label: New starter
members.description: The projected starter is not the quarterback who started the team's last game.

members.label: QB status (news)
members.description: From the week's reporting: 0 healthy starter, 1 questionable or limited, 2 backup starting or unknown.

members.label: Risky throw rate
members.description: Share of passes charted as interception-worthy (FTN, 2022+).

groups.name: Health
groups.heading: Who's playing
groups.description: Who is missing from the lineup, weighted by how much the position matters.

members.label: Injury impact
members.description: Starters listed Out or Doubtful (half for Questionable), weighted by position: QB 5, tackles, edge rushers, top corner and top receiver 2, others 1.

members.label: Starters out
members.description: Depth-chart starters listed Out or Doubtful.

members.label: Offensive line starters out
members.description: Starting centers, guards and tackles listed Out or Doubtful.

members.label: Players on the injury report
members.description: Players with an Out, Doubtful or Questionable game status.

members.label: Injury impact (news)
members.description: From the week's reporting: 0 nothing notable, 1 a role player or two, 2 a key starter, 3 several key starters or the QB.

groups.name: Form
groups.heading: The moment
groups.description: Recent results and trajectory: is the team hot or cold?

members.label: Win rate, last 3 games
members.description: Wins in the team's last three games (ties count half), across seasons.

members.label: Average margin, last 3 games
members.description: Average point margin over the last three games.

members.label: Streak
members.description: Current winning (+) or losing (−) streak.

members.label: Efficiency trend
members.description: Net EPA per play over the last four games minus the season average: improving (+) or slipping (−).

members.label: Beating expectations, last 3
members.description: Share of the last three games in which the team covered the betting spread.

groups.name: Stakes
groups.heading: The moment
groups.meaning: What the game means to them
groups.description: What the game means: trap games, playoff stakes, motivation.

members.label: Big game next week
members.description: How strong next week's opponent is compared with an average team (Elo points).

members.label: Coming off a big win
members.description: Last game was a win over a top-8 team or a primetime division win.

members.label: Out of contention
members.description: Week 13 or later with a win rate under 35%.

members.label: Coasting
members.description: Week 13 or later with a win rate over 80%.

members.label: Motivation (news)
members.description: From the week's reporting: −1 nothing to play for, 0 ordinary, +1 must-win.

members.label: Revenge game (news)
members.description: The week's coverage frames it as a revenge game.

members.label: Looking ahead (news)
members.description: The week's coverage frames it as a trap or look-ahead game.

groups.name: Rest & travel
groups.heading: The setup
groups.description: Rest days, byes, short weeks, travel distance and time zones.

members.label: Rest days
members.description: Days since the team's last game (capped at 14).

members.label: Off a bye
members.description: The team's previous game was 13 or more days ago.

members.label: Short week
members.description: The team's previous game was 4 or fewer days ago.

members.label: Travel distance
members.description: Distance from the team's home stadium to the venue.

members.label: Time zones crossed
members.description: Venue time zone minus home time zone (+ = traveled east).

members.label: Consecutive road games
members.description: Road or neutral games in a row, including this one.

groups.name: Venue & weather
groups.heading: The setup
groups.meaning: Where and in what; shifts home advantage only
groups.description: Where the game is played and in what conditions; these change how much home field is worth.

members.label: Neutral site
members.description: Played at a neutral site (international games, Super Bowl).

members.label: Division game
members.description: Division rivals, who know each other well.

members.label: Primetime
members.description: Kickoff at 7pm ET or later, or a Thursday or Monday game.

members.label: Dome
members.description: Played under a closed roof.

members.label: Artificial turf
members.description: Played on an artificial surface.

members.label: Temperature
members.description: Kickoff temperature in °C (planned).

members.label: Wind
members.description: Kickoff wind speed in km/h (planned).

members.label: Weather concern (news)
members.description: From the forecast: 0 dome or mild, 0.5 strong wind or rain, 1 severe.

groups.name: Coaching
groups.heading: The sidelines
groups.description: How the staff makes decisions, and how stable the staff is.

members.label: 4th-down aggressiveness
members.description: How often the team goes for it on 4th-and-short between the 35s, compared with the league.

members.label: Pass rate over expected
members.description: How much more often the team passes on early downs than the situation predicts.

members.label: Early-down pass rate
members.description: Share of first- and second-down plays that are passes.

members.label: Head coach tenure
members.description: Seasons the current head coach has led the team (planned).

members.label: First-year head coach
members.description: The head coach is in his first season with the team (planned).

members.label: Coaching turmoil (news)
members.description: From the week's reporting: 0 stable, 1 hot seat, firing or public criticism of play-calling.

members.label: Pass rate over expected when ahead
members.description: Pass rate over expected when leading by 7 or more (planned).

members.label: Pass rate over expected when behind
members.description: Pass rate over expected when trailing by 7 or more (planned).

members.label: Pace
members.description: Seconds per offensive play in neutral situations (planned).

members.label: Penalty yards per game
members.description: Penalty yards against per game (planned).

members.label: Head coach vs the spread
members.description: The head coach's career rate of covering the betting spread (planned).

groups.name: Offensive scheme
groups.heading: The sidelines
groups.meaning: How the offense is built (style; history decides what helps)
groups.description: How the offense is built: motion, play-action, formations, personnel. Style, not quality; history decides what helps.

members.label: Pre-snap motion
members.description: Share of plays with a player in motion before the snap (FTN, 2022+).

members.label: Play-action
members.description: Share of passes with a play-action fake (FTN, 2022+).

members.label: Run-pass options
members.description: Share of plays that are RPOs (FTN, 2022+; planned).

members.label: Screens
members.description: Share of passes that are screens (FTN, 2022+; planned).

members.label: Under center
members.description: Share of plays with the QB under center (FTN, 2022+; planned).

members.label: No-huddle
members.description: Share of plays run without a huddle (FTN, 2022+; planned).

members.label: Three-receiver sets (coordinator history)
members.description: How often the offensive play-caller has used 11 personnel in past seasons, relative to each season's league average (participation 2016+; coverage 2018+).

members.label: Heavy sets (coordinator history)
members.description: How often the play-caller has used two-plus tight ends or backs in past seasons, relative to each season's league average (participation 2016+; coverage 2018+).

members.label: Time to throw (coordinator history)
members.description: Average time to throw in the play-caller's past offenses, relative to each season's league average (participation 2016+).

groups.name: Defensive scheme
groups.heading: The sidelines
groups.description: How the defense is built: blitzes, boxes, coverage habits. Style, not quality.

members.label: Blitz rate
members.description: Share of opponent dropbacks with at least one blitzer (FTN, 2022+).

members.label: Stacked boxes vs the run
members.description: Share of opponent runs faced with 8+ defenders in the box (FTN, 2022+).

members.label: Five-plus rushers
members.description: Share of dropbacks with five or more pass rushers (FTN, 2022+; planned).

members.label: Man coverage (coordinator history)
members.description: How often the defensive play-caller has played man coverage in past seasons, relative to each season's league average (participation 2016+; coverage 2018+).

members.label: Two-high shells (coordinator history)
members.description: How often the play-caller has played two-deep safety shells in past seasons, relative to each season's league average (participation 2016+; coverage 2018+).

members.label: Pressure rate (coordinator history)
members.description: Pressure rate in the play-caller's past defenses, relative to each season's league average (participation 2016+).

groups.name: Matchups
groups.heading: The sidelines
groups.description: This offense's habits against this defense's habits (planned).

members.label: Play-action vs a defense that struggles with it
members.description: Offense's play-action habit times the defense's results against play-action (planned).

members.label: Blitz vs an offense that struggles with it
members.description: Defense's blitz habit times the offense's results against the blitz (planned).

members.label: Motion vs a defense that struggles with it
members.description: Offense's motion habit times the defense's results against motion (planned).

members.label: Power runs vs light boxes
members.description: Under-center run game against a defense that plays light boxes (planned).

members.label: Offense vs man coverage
members.description: Offense's results against man coverage times the defense's man rate (planned).

members.label: Offense vs pressure
members.description: Offense's results under pressure times the defense's pressure rate (planned).

members.label: Three-receiver sets vs the defense
members.description: Offense's 11-personnel results against the defense's results versus 11 personnel (planned).

groups.name: Market behavior
groups.heading: The outside world
groups.meaning: How the betting market is behaving (not what it predicts)
groups.description: How the betting market is behaving: line movement and where the public is. Never the line itself (ADR 0013); live only, so it contributes nothing to backtests.

members.label: Line movement
members.description: How far the spread has moved toward the home team since the week's first snapshot (live only).

members.label: Public betting on the home team
members.description: Share of spread bets on the home team from consensus pages (live only).

groups.name: Buzz
groups.heading: The outside world
groups.description: The mood of the week's coverage (live only).

members.label: Media sentiment
members.description: Tone of the week's coverage of the team, from −1 (negative) to +1 (positive).

members.label: Hype
members.description: How much national coverage the team is getting this week, 0 to 1.

pass_rate.label: Pass rate
pass_rate.help: Share of plays that are passes (including sacks and scrambles).

pass_rate_faced.label: Pass rate faced
pass_rate_faced.help: Share of opponent plays that are passes.

success_rate.label: Success rate

success_rate_allowed.label: Success rate allowed

epa_per_play.label: EPA per play
epa_per_play.help: Expected points added per play; around 0 is average.

epa_per_play_allowed.label: EPA allowed per play
epa_per_play_allowed.help: Expected points the defense allows per play; lower is better.

motion_rate.label: Pre-snap motion
motion_rate.help: Share of plays with a player in motion before the snap (FTN charting).

play_action_rate.label: Play-action
play_action_rate.help: Share of passes with a play-action fake (FTN charting).

rpo_rate.label: RPO rate
rpo_rate.help: Share of plays that are run-pass options (FTN charting).

screen_rate.label: Screen rate
screen_rate.help: Share of passes that are screens (FTN charting).

shotgun_rate.label: Shotgun rate
shotgun_rate.help: Share of plays with the QB in shotgun.

under_center_rate.label: Under center
under_center_rate.help: Share of plays with the QB under center (FTN charting).

no_huddle_rate.label: No-huddle rate
no_huddle_rate.help: Share of plays run without a huddle.

fourth_down_go_rate.label: 4th-down go rate
fourth_down_go_rate.help: Share of 4th downs the offense goes for it rather than punting or kicking.

blitz_rate.label: Blitz rate
blitz_rate.help: Share of opponent dropbacks with at least one blitzer (FTN charting).

pass_rushers_5plus_rate.label: 5+ pass rushers
pass_rushers_5plus_rate.help: Share of opponent dropbacks with five or more rushers (FTN charting).

box_8plus_vs_run_rate.label: 8+ in the box vs runs
box_8plus_vs_run_rate.help: Share of opponent runs faced with 8 or more defenders in the box.

box_6minus_vs_run_rate.label: Light box vs runs
box_6minus_vs_run_rate.help: Share of opponent runs faced with 6 or fewer defenders in the box.
